home.title: The opening price is your subscription price.
home.subtitle: Creators set the raise and mint schedule. After the sale window, finalize injects the pool at the sale price and locks LP forever. New creates are mint mining (RADR-style) only.
home.pillarNoWithdrawBody: Raised funds have two destinations: the pool, or pro-rata refunds to subscribers. No withdraw function exists in the contracts.
home.pillarLpLockedBody: The genesis liquidity share belongs to the Locker and can never be withdrawn. Third parties can add and remove only their own liquidity.
home.pillarFairOpenBody: Funding, initialisation and opening happen inside the same finalize transaction, so there is no window to front-run.
home.pillarFeeSplitBody: In mint mode, buys and sells in this pool can take a token tax (burn / community / foundation / tech), fixed at creation. The four-way quote-fee split applies only to existing standard launches.
home.noLaunches: No launches yet. Run <cmd>npm run contracts:deploy</cmd>, then <cmd>npm run seed</cmd>.
home.noLaunchesPublic: No launches yet. Connect a wallet and try Create.

phase.PENDING_hint: The subscription window has not opened yet.
phase.OPEN_hint: Accepting subscriptions at a fixed price. A subscription cannot be withdrawn before the window ends.
phase.AWAITING_FINALIZE_hint: The window has closed. Anyone can call finalize to settle and open the pool.
phase.SUCCEEDED_hint: Settled; the pool opened at the subscription price. Subscribers can claim tokens and any oversubscription refund.
phase.REFUNDING_hint: The launch did not open. The whole supply was burned and subscribers can take their full commitment back.

create.title: Create a Portus launch.
create.intro: Create currently supports mint mining (RADR-style) only. Every parameter is written into the contract at creation and cannot be changed afterward. Raised funds can only enter the pool or return to subscribers — never your wallet.
create.connectTitle: Creating a launch needs a wallet.
create.connectBody: This wallet becomes the launch creator: it signs the create transaction and the EIP-712 authorisations for the whitelist and copy. It has no power over raised funds.
create.name: Token name (1–32 bytes)
create.freezableWarning: This asset's issuer can freeze addresses (e.g. a stablecoin blacklist). If the sale or pool is frozen, funds may be stuck — the contracts cannot defend against that.
create.noQuoteAssets: No quote assets registered yet. They are registered by the quoteAdmin multisig.
create.granularityAdjusted: Snapped to the nearest value that meets the price granularity rule (r·10⁶ ≤ R).
create.incentiveHint: Half of the incentive pool comes from each side, so sale and pool amounts match and the pool opens at the subscription price. Max 30%.
create.roundTripCost: Buying and immediately selling costs about {cost}
create.creatorShareHint: Max 40%. Recorded in phase 1; takes effect with the FeeSplitter.
create.treasuryModeHint: The treasury can only do what is chosen here; neither creator nor platform can withdraw.
create.whitelistHint: One address per line with its cap in whole quote units (5 = 5 WETH). Without a whitelist, the public phase must be on.
create.publicOpensAfter: Public phase opens after (hours from start)
create.underRule: If the target is not met
create.underRefund: Refund everyone in full and burn the supply
create.underShrink: Shrink: open at the same price with a smaller pool
create.immutableAck: I understand every parameter is immutable after creation.
create.noWithdrawAck: I understand raised funds never reach my wallet; they only go into the pool or back to subscribers.
create.done: Done. The launch is on chain:
create.blockWrongNetwork: Wallet is on the wrong network; switch to the deployed one
create.blockFdv: A valid FDV (above 0) and incentive share of 0–30%
create.blockRecipient: Creator recipient is not a valid address (leave empty for yourself)
create.blockWhitelist: The whitelist CSV has an error
create.blockNoPhase: Upload a whitelist or enable the public phase
create.blockAckImmutable: Tick “all parameters are immutable after creation”
create.blockAckNoWithdraw: Tick “raised funds never reach my wallet”
create.blockAckFreezable: Tick the freezable quote asset acknowledgement
create.blockNoClient: Wallet not connected or the chain RPC is unavailable; refresh and reconnect
create.statusAwaiting: Fill in the parameters and submit.
create.creatorRecipientHint: Empty = the connected wallet. Immutable after creation.
create.treasuryModeBuyback: Buy back and burn the token
create.releaseRateHint: 0.1%–1%. At 0.3%, linear release empties in about {days} days.
create.freezableAck: I understand this quote asset can be frozen by its issuer; a frozen pool can never trade again and nobody can rescue it.
create.templateStandardHint: Fixed 1B supply, fixed-price sale, locked pool; four-way fee split and a daily-released incentive pool.
create.templateMintHint: A small initial supply (default 10M: half sold, half in the pool); the rest is minted month by month for holders and referrers; buys and sells pay a token tax.
create.templateOnlyMintNote: Standard sale is no longer offered on this create page. Existing on-chain standard launches remain; new creates are mint-only.
create.mintInitialHint: Half to subscribers, half paired with the raise in the pool; initial rewards 0% (customizable after contract upgrade).
create.mintMaxHint: Initial plus everything mined later; burns do not free up room.
create.mintScheduleHint: From the end of the sale, cumulative minted supply compounds every 30 days at the current phase's monthly rate (linear within a month) up to the cap; each day's mint goes to the Distributor. 0 months ends the list.
create.mintCapAt: Reaches the cap around month {month} ({years} years).
create.mintCapNever: At this pace the {months}-month plan ends below the cap; nothing more is minted after it.
create.mintStaticHint: This share of each day's mint is paid by holding rank; the other {dynamic}% by referral power.
create.mintRewardsNote: Static: holders ranked by 24h average balance, smallest first; a higher rank (more held) weighs more, ties share a rank. Dynamic: only the holdings of people you invited directly count — the largest one by its cube root, every other one ×10 up to 10,000 tokens and 1:1 above. One level only; your invitees' invitees never count. Each day the publisher posts a Merkle root within what was minted; claims open after a 24h challenge period.
create.mintTaxHint: Taken in tokens, only on trades in this pool; wallet transfers are untaxed. At most 10% per side.
create.mintDumpHint: When a sell moves the price by more than the threshold, the excess is withheld from the tokens sold: part burned, the rest to the market-management address. 0 turns it off.
create.mintAddrHint: Empty means your connected wallet. Fixed at creation.
create.blockMintSupply: A valid initial supply and cap (initial ≥ 2, cap ≥ initial)
create.blockMintSchedule: A valid schedule (0–20% monthly growth per phase, ≤ 600 months, static share 0–100%)
create.noApiCreated: The launch is on-chain. This public site has no API: the description and whitelist were not uploaded, and the new launch page appears after the site is rebuilt.
create.noApiWhitelist: Note: this public site has no API, so whitelist proofs cannot be served and whitelisted users cannot subscribe yet. The Merkle root is still written on-chain; enable the public phase if people should subscribe now.
create.mintFeeHint: Charged on every buy and sell at T (in tokens), only on trades in this pool; wallet transfers are free.
create.mintFeeRange: 1%–5% in 0.1% steps, default 1%. Fixed at creation.
create.mintFeeInvalid: Enter a value from 1 to 5 with at most one decimal.
create.mintFeeNote: The ecosystem share is a fixed 0.2% of volume, sent to the platform ecosystem address {eco}; the remaining T−0.2% goes to your wallet. No burn, no anti-dump levy.
create.mintShareTitle: Allocation of creator share {share} (% of creator share, sums to 100%)
create.mintShareWarn: Flywheel/treasury shares take effect after a contract upgrade; currently everything goes to the creator
create.mintSplitSum: Sums to 100%; amounts follow the initial supply live
create.mintSplitPriceHint: Opening price = subscription price requires Subscription = Pool.
create.mintSplitWarn: The contract currently fixes Subscription 50% / Pool 50%; custom splits take effect after a contract upgrade. Creation goes on-chain as 50/50.
create.blockMintSupplySplit: Supply split Subscription/Pool/Initial rewards must sum to 100%

launch.whitelistNotUploaded: The creator has not uploaded the whitelist yet, so proofs are not available.
launch.creator: Creator
launch.notWhitelisted: Your address is not on the whitelist.
launch.proofInvalid: The API's proof does not match the on-chain Merkle root; it was not used.
launch.noWithdrawNote: A subscription cannot be withdrawn before the window ends. Any oversubscription is refunded pro rata after settlement.
launch.finalizePending: The window has closed; anyone can call finalize.
launch.nothingToClaim: Nothing to claim for this address.
launch.connectToClaim: Connect a wallet to see and claim your tokens and refund.
launch.feeLine: Fee {fee} ({bps}%, charged in the quote asset)
launch.poolClosed: The pool is not open yet.
launch.lpLockedBody: The Locker holds {shares} genesis LP shares — exactly what was minted at opening — with no remove or transfer entry point.
launch.noDescription: (the creator has not submitted a description)
launch.creatorToolsBody: You created this launch. The whitelist and copy are uploaded with EIP-712 signatures; the API rebuilds the Merkle tree and rejects it if it does not match the on-chain root.
launch.frontrunNote: A large first buy after opening can be sandwiched. Set a sensible slippage and deadline.
launch.treasuryActionsNote: Anyone can trigger these; on-chain cooldowns, a TWAP price guard and per-call caps apply.
launch.releaseDecaying: decaying, {rate}% of the remainder per day
launch.flywheelBought: Bought back by the platform flywheel
launch.lpNote: The genesis LP is locked forever; this is your own liquidity and can be removed any time. Fees do not enter the reserves — LPs are rewarded through the radar's LP mining.
launch.mintDailyHint: Anyone can call it; it mints only what the schedule allows, straight into the Distributor.
launch.mintCapNone: The plan ends below the cap; nothing more is minted after it.
launch.mintTaxDump: Anti-dump: above {threshold} sell slippage the excess is withheld, {burn} of it burned, the rest to market management
launch.mintRewardsRule: Each day's mint splits into static and dynamic parts: static by 24h average holding rank (more held, higher rank, more weight); dynamic counts only the holdings of people you invited directly (largest by cube root, others ×10 up to 10,000 tokens and 1:1 above), one level only. Copy your invite link on the My page.
launch.mintLpNote: Mint-mode pools issue no LP shares and have no add or remove entry point: the liquidity seeded at opening stays in the pool forever.
launch.rewardsHint: Merkle claims stay. Mint rewards show static/dynamic splits under the amount when present; claim after the challenge window.

errors.NotOpen: The subscription window is not open.
errors.PublicNotOpen: The public phase has not opened yet.
errors.UnsupportedQuoteToken: Unsupported quote asset (amount received differs from amount sent).
errors.NotAwaitingFinalize: Cannot settle now (window still open, or already settled).
errors.SlippageExceeded: The price moved beyond your slippage tolerance.
errors.InsufficientOutput: Too small: nothing is left after the fee.
errors.NotInitialized: The pool is not open yet.
errors.PriceNotGranular: The raise target does not meet the price granularity rule.
errors.FdvOutOfBounds: FDV is outside the range allowed for this quote asset.
errors.NoSubscriptionPath: No whitelist and no public phase: nobody could subscribe.
errors.InvalidPublicPhase: Invalid public phase time or cap.
errors.QuoteAssetNotAllowed: This quote asset is not allowed.
errors.userRejected: You rejected the request in your wallet.

devTools.title: Local demo tools (local chain only)
devTools.body: These do not exist on a real network: mint test tokens and move the chain clock to the next phase boundary.

me.title: Me
me.referralBody: Mint mining counts one level only: each person who binds you as referrer is one zone, scored by their holdings. The largest zone (major) counts by cube root; other zones ×10 up to 10,000 tokens and 1:1 above. Invitees of invitees never count — no umbrella team stats.
me.bindPromptBody: You opened an invite link. Binding cannot be changed later and places you in their direct zone for mint dynamic power. You can also bind later on the Me page.
me.inviteesEmpty: No one has bound you via your link yet.
me.zonesNoMint: No mint launches to show zone holdings yet.
me.zonesUnavailable: Zone data unavailable (API not ready or index not synced).
me.zonesEmpty: No direct zones yet. Share your link and have them bind.
me.zonesNote: Holdings below are live on-chain balances for preview; daily mint dynamic rewards settle on 24h TWAB. The largest holding is marked major zone.
